defects.problem: At phone-feed size the screenshot shrinks to a thumbnail. The highlighted Cancel subscription control and the numbered badge are a few pixels tall and unreadable. The payoff of the hook (the answer to 'Where do I press?') is carried only by the word 'There.' and not by the highlight.
defects.fix: Keep the layout, but enlarge the screen panel in the payoff beat by giving the headline column less width (no zoom or pan of the footage itself), or drop the right-hand text to a single line so the screen can sit larger.

defects.problem: The highlight cut-out is a hard white rectangle that sits over the redaction bars and the support-line text, so black bars butt against the white patch. The yellow '1' badge overlaps the billing-address redaction bar. Expiry and CVC are covered by one long black bar that runs past the Expiry field into the CVC field. The area around the target looks cluttered and patched, not clean.
defects.fix: Make the cut-out tight to the button with a small even margin, and keep redaction bars inside their own field bounds so they do not touch the cut-out or the badge.

defects.problem: The headline 'Where do I press?' is on screen at 90px, and the same words appear again as a caption at about 3.0s ('"Where do I press?"'). Then the headline repeats once more, smaller, above 'There.'. The same line is shown three times. A caption is also missing around 3.5s (blank caption row in the sheet).
defects.fix: Replace the 3.0s caption with different text or remove it. Keep one caption slot filled continuously so the lower third does not blink empty.

defects.problem: The four-plus seconds before the answer is a static screenshot with a headline and no movement or event. Muted, it reads as a title card, not a hook, and the screenshot text (Cancel subscription button) is small even at full size.
defects.fix: Bring the highlight in earlier, or shorten the static setup so the answer appears sooner. Do not add zoom.

defects.problem: The setup-to-answer transition is a crossfade where the large 'Where do I press?' and the 'There.' text ghost over each other and the screen dims at the same time. It is clean but busy, and the old headline reflows to a smaller size in the same crossfade.
defects.fix: Hold the headline size and position through the dissolve, and only swap the second line.

defects.problem: A large empty band on the right under 'There.' and below the headline column. The screen panel is anchored top-left while text floats mid-right, so the composition feels loosely balanced.
defects.fix: Align the headline block to the panel's vertical center or top edge and use the same left/right margins as the panel.

couldNotAssess: Motion quality of the 4.05s dissolve and the cursor entrance
Audio and narration timing against captions
Whether the highlight pulse or cursor animates in the payoff beat
oneLineVerdict: Stable, honest and cleanly cut, but at feed size the hook's payoff highlight is unreadable and the highlight/redaction patchwork looks unpolished.
